chain: Lupp explicitly identifies UW04 as energy infrastructure of the Digital Park Fechenheim data-center campus.
Digital Realty's old owner release literally says FRA20 is developed at Digital Park Fechenheim. Old release provides identity only.
Digital Realty's exact FRA20 page has named facility fields and a map-hero marker at the literal coordinates, linked to its own address and FRA20 site code.
identity_and_locator.transform: Only source latitude/longitude reordered for GeoJSON; no numeric datum conversion.
identity_and_locator.scope: FRA20 constituent facility point used only as a locator for the same physical campus. It is not the UW04 building point, address, parcel, footprint, transformer location, entrance or whole-campus boundary.
identity_and_locator.curated_address_scope: Curated UW04 and campus addresses remain the named campus/locality. FRA20's exact street address is retained only as constituent locator evidence, not falsely assigned as UW04's own address.
identity_and_locator.accuracy_caveat: Six-place decimals do not imply surveyed accuracy. No numerical positional accuracy is supplied.
identity_and_locator.stable_identity: Existing unselected FRA20 campus key is preserved for one Fechenheim campus. The old current-facility-build project is not refreshed or relabelled as UW04; the proposed substation has a separate new project key.

old_release_dates.selection: identity only; no fresh physical status

identity_and_locator.crs_trace: Current FRA20 HTML and page code map exact facility coordinates and site code into the map hero. Its empty coordinate overrides use facility lat/lng; empty second line falls back to FRA20 siteCodeName. A labelled marker uses that same pair. Current runtime maps module IDs to the exact reused 5170/2881/1438 filenames. Map code passes unchanged lat/lng to Google's LatLng; official provider documentation explicitly uses WGS84.
identity_and_locator.static_proof_limits: No paid Maps API request, map screenshot, geocoder, guessed center, sampled road point, arbitrary parcel centroid, imagery reuse or private API used. No source code or API-key literals redistributed.

rights.lupp: Public ordinary article and index; footer ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. Compact independently restated factual progress/identity only, no text/photo redistribution.
rights.digital_realty: German page footer Alle Rechte vorbehalten. Isolated factual operator coordinate and factual identity extraction; no open-license claim. Only bounded implementation-trace metadata retained.
rights.google: Official documentation footer links CC-BY 4.0. Documentation convention fact has Google attribution. This does not license map data, imagery, operator points or code.
rights.distribution_scope: All raw third-party content stays temporary; tracked files contain only compact factual metadata, coordinates and provenance.

dedup.method: Each complete stored GeoJSON geometry transformed from WGS84 into a local azimuthal-equidistant projection centered at the FRA20 point; shortest point-to-full-geometry distances computed. Polygon interiors were checked in the original geometry. This is duplicate screening, not survey accuracy or containment proof.
dedup.identity_result: No selected Fechenheim/FRA20/UW04/Hugo-Junkers campus alias found. Distinct from Frankfurt Westside, Rödelheim, Sossenheim, Neu-Isenburg and Schwalbach campuses. FRA18/FRA20/UW04 would remain one physical Fechenheim site if subsequently considered.

successor_check.finding: Bounded named search and current primary bodies did not identify authoritative UW04 completion or cancellation by August 20. Existing FRA18 opening and FRA20 spring 2027 forecast are not UW04 completion. Absence is not proven.

An old 2023 trade article distinguishes earlier halls and planned substations; it is not fresh 2026 work evidence or a selected successor source.
